caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a brown wooden table with an octagonal top and elaborate carved details. The table stands on a central pedestal shaped like a lyre, with ornamental carved elements and three vertical rods within its form. The pedestal is mounted on four splayed legs, each decorated with carved rope-like details and ending in claw-shaped feet with rounded tips. Below the table, three separate inset drawings are shown: at the left is a four-petaled flower-shaped ornament; in the center is an elongated, curved, and leaf-carved decorative piece; and at right is a similar curved piece with a different pattern. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background with a rectangular border. The drawing is rendered in brown hues with variations to indicate wood texture and shading, and the inset pieces use similar color tones.
title: Card Table
